joints.attack_plan: Before approach, deep-read source and primary references. Independently build an external helper; do not read prior review helpers/outcomes or producer control results. Use stage seconds=200, terminate_grace_seconds=2, native outer=260 and the original fixed fixture/input parameters. Start one absolute 300-second monotonic control deadline BEFORE the first helper/import/setup; every setup, gap, failure, native call and wait counts; never reset it. Observe actual baseline PID and /proc start identity, parent identity, marker, and actual post-exec argv. lifecycle.py os.execv replaces the wrapper command: derive expected post-exec argv from baseline.py target plus its actual arguments, not from the pre-exec lifecycle wrapper argv. Retain observed cmdline and both command stages; recheck the same PID/start identity when delivering signals. Confirm kernel stopped state and bracket a SIGSTOP interval of >=125 monotonic seconds BY ITSELF before SIGCONT. A partial marker does not establish sleep start, elapsed sleep, stopped state or quiet duration. Independently measure the actual observer event-free gap >120 seconds and observer liveness, then require completed closed output, native checker completion and genuine OS wait acknowledgments. Keep the persistent main parent/supervisor and observer alive until all native waits and checks finish; a helper assertion must not exit and reparent/kill live native children. Preserve cleanup, failures and waits even on a failed condition. After failure or the single call, never launch another fixture; retain all bytes and report the exact missing witness. No source/time mocking or replacement of native closure/identity checks.
